name: Subscription vending
short_description: Subscription vending is an Azure landing zone pattern that automates the creation of new Azure subscriptions, placing them in the right management group with policies, access and logging preconfigured, typically through infrastructure as code such as Bicep.

evidence.quote: What actually works is a model called subscription vending.
This is where subscription vending comes in. A repeatable pipeline that creates new subscriptions on demand.
subscription vending, baseline security and logging, network patterns, identity workflows
